messages:
maya: Heads-up — toolbar chips overflow in the new Console layout is pushing the table controls below the fold on 1280x720. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/shot/toolbar-overflow.png 

sam: can you repro with reduced zoom? might be a spacing token regression from the token rename last week.

jordan: I saw this on my laptop too. Chips wrap onto two lines and the filter dropdown gets hidden behind the table header. feels cramped. :grimacing:

maya: repro steps: open dataset view -> narrow window to 1280x720 -> add 5 filters -> observe chips wrap -> table action column moves down.

sam: curious whether we should collapse chips into a single horizontal scrollable row instead of wrapping. that preserves row height.

jordan: horizontal scroll is ok on desktop but not great for keyboard users. maybe we use an overflow counter like “+3” that opens a popover with the rest?

liam: accessibility angle: if we make it scrollable, ensure focus isn't trapped and that keyboard users can reach hidden chips. aria-hidden on overflowed content is a no-go.

eva: product: priority is discoverability of filters and quick access to table actions. leaning away from hiding filters behind a popover unless we also keep clear affordance for add/remove.

maya: mock for +N popover: https://figma.com/redwood/infer/toolbar-overflow-v2 (bottom of file). Also tried compact spacing tokens: felt better but broke button hit target in mobile.

sam: can you paste the small CSS tweak i tried? i added a min-height to the chip row and made chips shrink:

```
.chips-row {
  min-height: 40px;
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--spacing-2);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.chip {
  flex: 0 1 auto; /* allow shrink */
  max-width: 220px;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
```

jordan: looks reasonable. question: tokens used: var(--spacing-2) vs the new compact tokens? we should reference token alias so future renames don't break layout.

sam: updated to var(--space-compact-2) in my branch. but that had side effect on button vertical padding, which reduced hit area.

liam: button hit target must remain >=44px visible area for touch. if compact tokens reduce that, we need an exception for interactive controls.

eva: decision proposal: use +N overflow popover for small widths, horizontal scroll for medium widths, keep full chips on large. Add a token exception for interactive padding so buttons keep 44px min.

maya: +1 for progressive approach. can we also ensure toast placement doesn't overlap the popover? we had a bug where toasts anchored bottom-right covered the +N menu.

sam: good call — toast z-index is currently 800, popover is 750. i'll raise toast z-index to 700? wait that'd be lower. will make popover z-index 900 so it sits above toasts.

jordan: aside: toast duration — design wants 3s for success, 5s for info/errors. should we tweak? Animations currently also cover focus outlines when popover appears.

accessibility-bot: Checklist suggestion:
- Ensure popover receives focus on open and returns focus on close.
- Popover menu items must be reachable via arrow keys.
- Provide screen-reader label for the +N control (e.g., "Show 3 hidden filters").
- Verify toast is announced by polite live region when relevant.

maya: i'll put together a small PR with:
- chips row flex-shrink solution + aria label for +N
- responsive breakpoint behavior (desktop/medium/mobile)
- token exception for button min-height
- popover z-index bump and focus management

sam: ping me when PR is ready, i'll run visual diff and perf check (batching impact).

eva: i'll update the product doc with the progressive behavior decision.

jordan: can we add a quick a11y note in the component docs about token exceptions? helps future audits.

maya: thanks everyone. will post PR link here. design-bot: snapshot uploaded to design-preview (build 48).

design-bot: design-preview build 48: https://design-preview.redwood/48 — visual diffs: 2 failed, 14 passed.

maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/194 — includes tests and a11y checks.

sam: reviewed, left one comment about using aria-expanded on +N button. small change then merge. :thumbsup:

liam: i'll run keyboard nav test after merge. if anything flakey i'll file an issue.

eva: thanks all, moving to accepted for the next release. :tada:
